head: mlp_691200
claim_scope: Two predetermined validation trajectories per boundary; development pilot only, no final-cohort confirmation.
input_output_contract: One host-resident displacement and velocity field, scalar physical wave speed; return displacement and physical velocity on the requested mesh at all 49 observation times, on host. Homogeneous unforced equation.
force_scale: initial displacement mass-L2 norm / horizon squared
affine_forcing: Retained exactly, including nonzero offset. Supplied speed enters timed setup and propagation.
full_field_audit: All full-grid same-grid references and learned bank tables plus every first-repetition ROM coefficient state saved; common-grid outputs retained for every method. Repetition hashes retained.
